item.title: CBP is monitoring US drivers and detaining those with suspicious travel patterns
item.description:
📝 Border Patrol is using hidden license plate readers to track drivers and flag “suspicious” travel patterns, an AP investigation found, raising concerns over secret surveillance. Texas law enforcement agencies have asked Border Patrol to use facial recognition to identify drivers, documents show. Customs and Border Protection, into something more akin to a domestic intelligence operation.
🔗 Read more: https://apnews.com/article/immigration-border-patrol-surveillance-drivers-ice-trump-9f5d05469ce8c629d6fecf32d32098cd

item.title: Mozilla Says It's Finally Done with Two-Faced Onerep
item.description:
📝 This week, Mozilla announced its partnership with Onerep will officially end next month. Image Mozilla Monitor Plus video on Youtube. In a statement published Tuesday, Mozilla said it will soon discontinue Monitor Plus, which offered data broker site scans and automated personal data removal from Onerep.
🔗 Read more: https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/11/mozilla-says-its-finally-done-with-two-faced-onerep/
